english.title: Underpaying vehicle excise duty
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) used on a public road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), a mechanically propelled vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), in such a way as to render the vehicle subject to a higher rate of duty than that paid for the vehicle licence then in force without having paid that higher rate before the vehicle was so used.
english.legislation: Contrary to section 37(1) and (2) of the Vehicle Excise and Registration Act 1994.
english.pointstoprove:
use on a public road
a mechanically propelled vehicle
in such a way as to render
the vehicle subject to higher rate of duty

english.notes:
(i) Care must be taken to ensure that the nature of the vehicle and the use to which it has been put is made clear.
(ii) Statement of Facts procedure applies - for wording see end of document.
english.standardstatementoffacts:
At **(..SPECIFY TIME..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE..) the defendant used on **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..) **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..) so that a higher rate of duty became chargeable because **(..SPECIFY CHANGE OF USE..). The higher rate duty was not paid before the vehicle was used.

The annual rate of duty at the time the vehicle licence was taken out was **(..SPECIFY RATE OF DUTY..). The relevant rate of duty for the use of the vehicle was **(..SPECIFY RELEVANT RATE OF DUTY..).
Back duty is claimed in the sum of **(..SPECIFY SUM..).

other.penalty:
An excise penalty being the greater of either:

A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale.
or
Five times the difference between the duty actually paid and the amount of duty at the higher rate.

Where the defendant was the keeper at the time of the offence an additional payment shall be ordered on conviction as specified in section 38(2) of the Vehicle Excise and Registration Act 1994 (commonly known as back duty).

Time limit for prosecutions:
36 months
